thread:
Ellen Park: Quick heads-up 10d before ArborHealth renewal. Need a concise SLA pack: 30d + 90d uptime, p95 latency (main), p99 appendix, short incident bullets, fallback counts, and a plain-language credits worked example. Can Eng + Billing + Legal help assemble? :page_facing_up:

Marco Ruiz: I can pull the metrics. Service id? Regions? Also, do we show region-level vs global weighted uptime?

Ellen Park: Service = arbor-prod-nlg. Regions: us-east-1 primary, eu-west-1 standby. Yes show both region-level and a weighted global example (weights = request volume). Note: customer uses Dedicated reserved pool during nightly batch windows; those windows are excluded from standard credit calculations per contract.

Jamie O'Neill: I'll draft the customer-facing paragraph and an "FAQ: how credits work". Quick Q: are we using standard credit tiers or customer-specific ones for Arbor?

BillingBot: Customer-specific tiers on file (contract AR-2026-78): >=99.95% = 0% credit; 99.9-99.95% = 3% credit; 99.5-99.9% = 8% credit; <99.5% = 12% credit. Credits are pro-rata against monthly committed spend and applied as billing adjustments on the next invoice after validation.

Priya Rao: Legal says include this blurb exactly and link to the contract: "Credits calculated pro-rata against the customer's monthly committed spend. Issuance requires Redwood validation." I'll paste the contract clause into the packet once BillingBot confirms.

Marco Ruiz: Pulling metrics now. Command I'll run for reproducibility: ```bash
# 30d p95 + uptime by region
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/summary?service=arbor-prod-nlg&period=30d&group=region" | jq .
```
I'll upload CSV + Grafana images to /shared/reports/arborhealth/3102468000.

Marco Ruiz: Quick heads-up: fallback routing to eu-west-1 was used 7 times in the last 90d during infra upgrades; each failover <1 minute. I'll annotate those timestamps in the CSV.

Jamie O'Neill: For the customer paragraph I'll keep tone: "what we measured", "what it means for you", "next steps". Also adding a short worked example and a one-line note about Dedicated windows being excluded.

Marco Ruiz: Uploaded: metrics_30d_90d.csv and grafana_snapshots.zip. Raw summary: us-east-1 uptime_30d=99.918%, us-east-1 uptime_90d=99.941%; eu-west-1 uptime_90d=99.996%; p95_us-east-1=185ms; p99_us-east-1=480ms; fallback_count_90d=7.

Jamie O'Neill: Draft one-pager uploaded to the folder. Worked credit example (regional):
- Monthly commit = $25,000
- Observed (30d, us-east-1) = 99.918% -> falls into 99.5-99.9 => 8% credit = $2,000
I also added a weighted global example using request split (us-east-1 87%, eu-west-1 13%): weighted uptime = 0.87*99.918 + 0.13*99.996 = ~99.933% -> falls into 99.9-99.95 => 3% credit = $750. Included exact math in appendix.

Ellen Park: Good — include an explicit worked example showing how we exclude Dedicated windows from the calculation (short note + pseudocode). Also add an FAQ entry: "Why might my regional and global credit differ?"

Priya Rao: Legal blurb uploaded. Also added a short checklist to confirm: metrics CSV, Grafana images, incident bullets, one-pager, legal text, credit calc slide. We'll need sign-off from CS lead before sending to renewals.

BillingBot: Confirmed contract clause and added link to contract AR-2026-78 in the folder.

Marco Ruiz: Small note from metrics: the 30d us-east value is sensitive to a single 18-minute maintenance window (scheduled) that we exclude from SLA if pre-notified per contract. I marked that row in the CSV and included the scheduled maintenance window ID. If CS wants it included we can show both inkl. and excl. versions.

Jamie O'Neill: Added both versions to the slides (incl/excl scheduled maint). Customer-facing draft uses the excluded figure and we call out the scheduled maint in a footnote.

Ellen Park: Timeline: internal review tomorrow 9am PT, customer packet final by tomorrow EOD. Please ping this thread when each item (metrics CSV, slides, legal snippet, credit calc) is uploaded and when CS lead signs off. If we need to adjust tiers for Arbor, flag now.

Marco Ruiz: Uploaded final CSV + annotated timestamps at /shared/reports/arborhealth/3102468000.

Jamie O'Neill: Slides & one-pager updated with final math and FAQ. Ready for review.

Priya Rao: Legal confirms language. Marking ready for CS lead sign-off.

Ellen Park: Thanks team 1 will run the review in the morning and loop in renewals after sign-off. If anything blocks the timing, call it out here. :thumbsup:
